newsitem.title: USA: New West Eyeworks sees Q4 net loss.
newsitem.headline: New West Eyeworks sees Q4 net loss.

text.p: New West Eyeworks Inc, a retailer of eyewear and contact lenses, on Monday said severe weather in the northwestern United States diminished December sales and will lead to a net loss for the fourth quarter.
Physical damage to company stores was "minimal", but lost revenue totaled about $500,000, New West said in a statement.
"The reduction in December revenues will cause New West to report a slight net loss in its fourth quarter," said Barry Feld, chief executive officer.
Based on preliminary results, revenues for the year ended Dec. 28, 1996, should be about $43.9 million, a 9.8 percent increase from $40 million in 1995.
Same-store sales rose 8.8 percent for 1996 when compared with the previous year.
